decisions.reason: Maintenance oil is a core recurring-demand accessory that supports the firm's oiled surface treatments and customer care journey.
The care line for oiled floors generates repeat purchases at low cost and complements the established flooring offer, though it overlaps somewhat with the maintenance oil.
Moisture-protection underlay is a standard installation accessory that installers and retailers expect alongside the floors.
High-density underlay serves acoustic and commercial installations, but it is a candidate for consolidation with other underlays as the firm streamlines accessories.
